ruleDefinitions.name: Webshell Hacking Activity Patterns
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects certain parent child patterns found in cases in which a web shell is used to perform certain credential dumping or exfiltration activities on a compromised system

sequences.query: ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\caddy\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\httpd\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\nginx\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\php\\-cgi\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\w3wp\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\ws\\_tomcatservice\\\.exe$")) OR ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\java\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\javaw\\\.exe$")) AND (parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\-tomcat\\-.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\tomcat.*"))) OR ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\java\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\javaw\\\.exe$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*catalina\\\.jar.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*CATALINA\\_HOME.*")))) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*rundll32.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*comsvcs.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-hp.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ a\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-m.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*net.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ user\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/add.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*net.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ localgroup\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ administrators\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/add.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\ntdsutil\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\ldifde\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\adfind\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\procdump\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\Nanodump\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\vssadmin\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\fsutil\\\.exe$")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-decode\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-NoP\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-W\\ Hidden\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/decode\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/ticket\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ sekurlsa.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dmp\\ full.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.downloadfile\\(.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.downloadstring\\(.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*FromBase64String.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*process\\ call\\ create.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*reg\\ save\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*whoami\\ \\/priv.*")))
